packageRules.description: Firebase modules are pinned by a BOM. Bumping one without the others produces a mutually incompatible set, so they move together or not at all.
Same reasoning as Firebase — the Compose BOM pins every compose module.
Supabase ships a BOM and its modules are version-locked to each other and to Ktor.
Kotlin, KSP, and the Compose compiler plugin are version-locked to one another. A Kotlin bump that leaves KSP behind does not build.

Kotlin is currently pinned at 2.0.21 by Supabase 3.0.x, which in turn pins the Firebase BOM to 33.x. Moving off it is a deliberate, separate piece of work — see TODO.md. This rule exists so the upgrade stays VISIBLE as a standing PR rather than being silently absent; do not close it without recording why.
Test-only dependencies can move on their own; grouping them with production upgrades makes both harder to review.
